recompute: payload_hash = sha256(JCS(canonical)) as lowercase hex, where JCS is RFC 8785: UTF-8, keys sorted by code point, no insignificant whitespace, nulls present. title_sha256 and body_sha256 are sha256 of the raw stored markdown as UTF-8 bytes — no normalisation, no trailing-newline rule; an absent title hashes the empty string.
